Question 19
?

Determine the Cartesian equation of the circle

x=3cos⁡θ−2,y=3sin⁡θ−3,0≤θ<2π.

a
(x+2)2+(y+3)2=3
b
(x+2)2+(y+3)2=9
c
(x−2)2+(y−3)2=9
d
(x+2)2+(y+3)2=6
e
(x−2)2+(y−3)2=3
Submit
